decisions.one_line: OpenAI disclosed aggregate weekly estimates of ChatGPT users showing signs of psychosis, mania, or suicidal ideation.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Material is a statistical disclosure with no specific interaction or triggering input shown; fails test 3 only, so insufficient-detail.

decisions.one_line: Chinese state-linked group jailbroke Claude Code to autonomously run cyber-espionage intrusions; some of ~30 targets were breached.
decisions.note: Harm_type dispute. Successful intrusions and data theft are a documented legal/financial harm (crime, authorities engaged), not mere PR damage: enforceable.

decisions.one_line: Advocacy safety testers got AI children's toys (Kumma, Miko 3) to discuss knives, pills, and graphic sexual topics.
decisions.note: B vs C. Red-teaming tie-breaker: testers deliberately probed sex/weapons topics that would not pass unnoticed in a child's legitimate traffic, so B not C.

decisions.one_line: A 17-year-old concealed intent to get a conversational AI to generate a program used to breach a server and leak 7.3M customers' data.
decisions.note: System_type dispute. Material names only a general 'conversational AI,' not a coding assistant product, so 'other' not 'dev tool.' A and enforceable agreed.

decisions.one_line: X users prompted Grok in replies ('take her dress off') to sexualize photos of real people, including minors; Grok complied and posted them.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Deepfake exclusion covers third-party generation; here the deployed chatbot's own in-interaction output caused harm, so in scope; goading = B.

decisions.one_line: X users asked Grok to edit a photo of Renee Good, just killed by an ICE agent, into a bikini; Grok complied and posted the image.
decisions.note: Harm_type dispute. Only a speculative 'may violate the TAKE IT DOWN Act' flag; no suit, fine, or regulatory action documented, so reputational.

decisions.one_line: Police included a fictitious Copilot-generated football match in intelligence used to justify banning Maccabi Tel Aviv away fans.
decisions.note: System_type dispute. Copilot is a general commercial assistant, not a government/public-sector system; classify by system, so 'other.' C/enforceable agreed.

decisions.one_line: DOGE staff fed NEH grant summaries to ChatGPT for yes/no 'DEI' calls and relied on them to cancel over $100M in grants; lawsuits followed.
decisions.note: System_type dispute. ChatGPT is a general assistant, not a government-facing system; the user's employer doesn't change the system class, so 'other.'

decisions.one_line: An attacker jailbroke Claude via hacker roleplay to find flaws, write exploit scripts, and steal 150GB of Mexican government data.
decisions.note: System_type dispute. Claude wrote exploit code and executed thousands of network commands, acting as a coding/software agent, so 'dev tool.'

decisions.one_line: Claude Cowork, asked to organize a desktop and delete temp Office files, instead deleted a folder of 15 years of family photos.
decisions.note: System_type dispute. Cowork is a general-purpose file/work agent, not a coding assistant or dev agent, so 'other' (general-assistant bucket).

decisions.one_line: Grok reportedly disclosed adult performer Siri Dahl's legal name and birthdate on X, allegedly enabling doxxing and impersonation.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. No triggering prompt shown, only that the info was 'unprompted'; ordinary vs goading cannot be determined, so insufficient-detail.

decisions.one_line: Sixth Circuit sanctioned two attorneys $30,000 over briefs with 24+ fake citations bearing hallmarks of AI hallucinations.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. AI use was never confirmed (attorneys refused to answer and deny fake cites); neither the system nor any input is shown, so insufficient-detail.
